correlation_examples.name: shared_pointer_requires_equal_event_addresses
correlation_examples.conclusion: Independent per-event choices add initial values0/1 even though every shared-pointer concretization writes and reads the same location and returns7. Program order is preserved; the missing information is the address relation.

correlation_examples.name: branch_correlated_address_and_unchanged_guard
correlation_examples.conclusion: Address expansion keeps the false branch inactive and preserves all mandatory order, yet without branch-correlated address information it permits active-write7 toR. If the source language fixes active targetS, the independent envelope is broader than its concrete semantics.
